role: Introduce Tally’s webhook capability and its limits
subject: Tally webhooks for new submissions
preview_text: Send form data as it arrives, without polling the API or exporting CSVs.
headline: Send each new submission to your webhook
body:
Today, we’re introducing Tally: an online form builder that can send new submissions into your automation workflows through webhooks.

When someone submits a form, Tally pushes the data to your webhook endpoint. No polling the API or exporting CSVs to collect what came in.

For production workflows, you can list delivery events, inspect responses, and retry failed webhook attempts. One limit to plan around: the endpoint has **10 seconds** to process and respond to each new submission. Longer processing should call another service internally.

The webhook documentation covers the capability, delivery details, and timeout so you can decide whether it fits the workflows your agency builds.
